verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms `terraform validate -json` runs successfully with structured diagnostics (terraform-probe-7), directly supporting configuration validation before planning, and the plan workflow itself is well documented (terraform-docs-2/15/24, terraform-probe-6). However, the evidence pack never mentions `terraform fmt` or any auto-formatting capability, so the 'auto-format' half of the story is unevidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on proof of `terraform fmt` (auto-formatting) integrated into the pre-plan workflow, and independent/community corroboration of the validate+format combo being used together in practice.
